notes.title: Level editor
notes.content:
Hello everyone, just a quick announcement to let you know that "A Simple Square" is still in development. I made the difficult decision to start from scratch and rebuild the game from the ground up, but all of the mechanics are complete.

To make up for the delay, I am excited to announce that I am currently working on a level editor. This will allow players to create and share their own levels, adding a new level of personalization and diversity to the game.

Thank you for your patience and support, and stay tuned for the next major update.

notes.title: Beta 2
notes.content:
⚠️ [b]If the game crashes on launch, please go to the game files and delete the "square.sav" file.[/b]

Beta 2 has been released! It includes world 2 and resolves a crash bug at the end of the game. Try it out and let us know what you think.

World 2 features a new mechanic that allows you to pass over certain tiles as many times as you want. I'll leave it for you to discover in game, have fun!

[h2]New Features and Changes[/h2]

[list]
[*] The save file is now encrypted
[*] Addition of world 2 (20 levels)
[*] Resolved crash at the end of the game
[*] Added a demo end screen
[/list]

notes.title: Thank you for your support
notes.content:
Hello everyone, I want to thank you for your participation in the demo version of my game. Your support is greatly appreciated.

I am working hard to make the game as interesting and fun as possible with the gameplay that I have in mind. There will be many updates to come, so don't hesitate to come and test it regularly. Furthermore, as a way to thank you, I have decided to give free access to the beta version until a very advanced stage of development.

Your feedback is welcome, so don't hesitate to give me your opinion.
